form.codeHint: Exactly 3 capital letters. Printed on every pole plate, e.g. BPL.

admin.title: Add municipal administrator
admin.name: Full name
admin.emailHint: Used to sign in to the municipal console.
admin.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with upper case, lower case and a digit. Share it privately; the administrator should change it after the first sign-in.
admin.created: Administrator {email} created. They can now sign in to the municipal console.

errors.CONFLICT: A user with this e-mail already exists.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the details and the password rules.

password.title: Change password
password.description: You stay signed in here; every other device is signed out.
password.nextHint: At least 10 characters with upper case, lower case and a digit.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.success: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
password.weak: The new password does not meet the rules, or is the same as the current one.
password.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
password.failed: The password could not be changed. Please try again.
